observation.visible_scene: A studio-like interior: grey walls, two metal shelving racks stacked with cardboard boxes in the back, a closed door, two bright softbox studio lights (one each side), and a white floor marked by a central yellow-and-white checkered lane running toward the viewer plus horizontal green bead boundary lines. Across the excerpt, a line of small bead-built kart figures (spherical-bead construction) travels across the lane from left to right.
visible_changes: Frames 1-4 show the lane empty, no figures present.
A red/maroon-hatted figure on a bead kart enters at the left edge (~frames 5-8), translates steadily rightward across the lane, and leaves the right edge by ~frame 16.
A green-hatted figure on a bead kart follows behind the first, becoming visible at the left ~frame 9, moving right, and remaining on the right side until it exits around frame 31.
A green-and-white dinosaur-like figure on a kart enters at the left ~frame 18, translates right, and exits by ~frame 34.
A blue spiky figure on a kart enters at the left ~frame 23, translates right, and exits by ~frame 39.
The four figures form a single-file queue moving in the same direction with roughly constant left-to-right spacing; each is occluded by the frame edge as it passes.
Background elements (shelves, lights, door, checkered lane, green lines) stay in fixed screen positions throughout, so the observed motion is object translation, not camera movement.
The final frames (40-41) return to an empty lane.
outside_clip_unknowns: Where the karts originate and where they are headed beyond the frame edges.
Whether the procession continues before frame 1 or after frame 41.
What propels the karts or sets their speed.
uncertain_details: Exact identities of the figures are inferred only from color/shape (red-hatted, green-hatted, green dinosaur-like, blue spiky); not confirmed.
Whether inter-figure spacing is perfectly constant or varies slightly is hard to measure from sampled frames.
Minor apparent size differences between figures could reflect depth or model scale; not resolved here.
